title: STILL-PRESENT: pool-cap 1 Pool_Exhaustion crisis can still never resolve — the W-2 margin clamp skips cap 1 (permanent crisis at a legal cap, fairness rule 4)
detail: The r4 claim closes W-2 for legal caps 1-2, but the clamp guard `pool_max_packets > 1` skips cap 1: pool_margin stays 2, so `len + 2 < 1` can never hold. The trigger still fires (anti-flap clamps to 0), producing a permanent crisis the player can never recover from — fairness rule 4 — and the fix has no durable regression pin.
recommended_fix: Clamp for all caps: pool_margin = min(CRISIS_RESOLVE_MARGIN, u32(pool_max_packets) - 1) (at cap 1 margin becomes 0, so len == 0 resolves). Add a shipped cap-1 resolve regression test.

title: data/crises.json display strings render through the byte-truncating draw_text_c with no ASCII guard — gate 6 scans only .odin sources, not catalog data
detail: display_name, set-piece id, and preventive_redesign come from data/*.json and validate non-empty only; any non-ASCII byte in them mojibakes in the banner and gets blessed into T2 captures. Shipped data is ASCII today — the path is unguarded for future authored content.
recommended_fix: Reject non-ASCII bytes in the rendered catalog fields (display_name, preventive_redesign, set-piece id) at catalogs_load, or extend gate 6 to scan data/*.json string values.
